description: Arguments accepted by the write-file tool.

path.description: Absolute path or project-root-relative path of the UTF-8 text file to replace. Maximum file size: 16 MiB.

content.description: Complete UTF-8 text to write to the file. Empty text is allowed. Maximum UTF-8 byte length: 16 MiB.

create_parent_directories.description: Create missing parent directories before writing.
